⚠️ **This type is _unstable_ and may change significantly in a way that the data won't be backwards compatible.**
A time-bounded, decodable segment of encoded audio.

A chunk is the fundamental temporal unit of an [`archetypes.AudioStream`](https://rerun.io/docs/reference/types/archetypes/audio_stream?speculative-link):
each logged row represents one segment that can be handed to the decoder
without referencing data from any other row (any cross-segment decoder
state is reset at segment boundaries marked by [`components.AudioDiscontinuity`](https://rerun.io/docs/reference/types/components/audio_discontinuity?speculative-link)
or [`components.AudioSeekable`](https://rerun.io/docs/reference/types/components/audio_seekable?speculative-link)).

The row's timeline timestamp is treated as the presentation timestamp (PTS)
of the first sample in the chunk. The number of PCM samples produced per
channel is carried alongside in [`components.AudioDurationSamples`](https://rerun.io/docs/reference/types/components/audio_duration_samples?speculative-link).
